name: Ironhide Bulwark
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, big and stocky, in riveted black iron armour plates, carrying a tall slab shield of riveted iron with glowing orange rivets in front of it, an ember in its free claw

poses.stand: hovering low, the tall riveted iron slab shield held in front of it, peeking over the top
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

move.action: paces forward with the heavy iron shield held in front, wings straining, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: peeks over the shield and lobs an ember forward to the right over the top of it

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
